--- a/tests/test_regression_double_cancel.py
+++ b/tests/test_regression_double_cancel.py
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+"""Regression: double-cancel must not re-add stock (C-300 oversell bug)."""
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from inventory_api import app as inventory
+from inventory_api.app import app
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+ALICE = {"Authorization": "Bearer token-alice"}
+BOB = {"Authorization": "Bearer token-bob"}
+
+def setup_function():
+    inventory.STOCK.update({"A-100": 100, "B-200": 20, "C-300": 3})
+    inventory.RESERVATIONS.clear()
+
+def test_double_cancel_does_not_inflate_stock():
+    rid = client.post("/reservations", json={"sku": "C-300", "qty": 2}, headers=BOB).json()["id"]
+    assert client.delete(f"/reservations/{rid}", headers=BOB).status_code == 200
+    # second cancel must not succeed / must not add stock again
+    second = client.delete(f"/reservations/{rid}", headers=BOB)
+    assert second.status_code in (404, 409), f"expected rejection, got {second.status_code} {second.json()}"
+    assert client.get("/stock/C-300").json()["available"] == 3
+
+def test_inflated_stock_cannot_cause_oversell():
+    rid = client.post("/reservations", json={"sku": "C-300", "qty": 2}, headers=BOB).json()["id"]
+    client.delete(f"/reservations/{rid}", headers=BOB)
+    client.delete(f"/reservations/{rid}", headers=BOB)
+    # only 3 exist, so reserving 5 must fail even after cancels
+    resp = client.post("/reservations", json={"sku": "C-300", "qty": 5}, headers=ALICE)
+    assert resp.status_code == 409

+++ b/tests/test_regression_negative_qty.py

+"""Regression: negative qty must not inflate stock (A-100 >100 bug)."""

+
+def setup_function():
+    inventory.STOCK.update({"A-100": 100, "B-200": 20, "C-300": 3})

+
+def test_negative_qty_rejected():
